summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a powerful hadith narration from Sahih Muslim about the last person to enter paradise. The speaker describes how this individual, despite being punished in hellfire for his sins, is eventually granted entry to paradise. When he approaches the gates and perceives paradise to be completely full, he returns three times expressing his concern to Allah. On the third occasion, Allah reveals to him that he will receive ten times the best pleasures of this world without any of its hardships—and this is merely the lowest reward in paradise. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that the vast majority of believers will receive even greater rewards that are beyond human comprehension, as Allah has prepared for the righteous slaves what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no heart has imagined. The speaker concludes by encouraging the audience that paradise is within reach through the Quran, the Sunnah, sincerity, and dedication.
